contract.name: ReadingSession
contract.description: Contract for managing the state and progress of a reader's session through the educational book.

capability.name: ReadingSession
capability.responsibility: Maintain the logical state and progress of the current reading session.

rules: A reading session has a stable session identifier.
A reading session has at most one current page.
Reading progress is derived from the logical position within the book.
The current page must refer to a valid page.
ReadingSession maintains reading state but does not own book structure.
ReadingSession does not own page navigation rules.
ReadingSession does not control narration playback.
ReadingSession does not directly depend on storage technology.
ReadingSession does not depend on a specific technology or provider.
ReadingSession exposes WHAT reading state is maintained, not HOW that state is stored.

errors.SESSION_NOT_FOUND: The requested reading session does not exist.
errors.SESSION_NOT_ACTIVE: The reading session is not active.
errors.PAGE_NOT_FOUND: The requested page identifier does not exist.
errors.SESSION_NOT_INITIALIZED: The reading session has not been initialized.
